query:
VALUE total INT64 = 0
VALUE i INT64 = 1
WHILE i <= $n THEN {
  SET total = total + i
  SET i = i + 1
}
RETURN total AS total
notes: Assume the evaluator supplies $n as the stated INT64 parameter; return a raw Database procedure body without DDL.
